parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The AppName of the live stream.

parameters.name: Stream

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the watermark template. Call the [DescribeLiveStreamWatermarks](~~2848102~~) operation to get the IDs of available watermark templates.

> The TemplateId parameter is used to replace the watermark template ID during a live stream.
